acceptanceCriteria: The package builds for an iOS 15 or newer simulator.
All nine states match the pinned upstream golden vectors at both tuned sizes.
Theme, speed, pause, Reduce Motion, shared-clock, and accessibility behavior are implemented.
The native iPhone and iPad demo builds and exposes adaptive settings controls and an all-state gallery.
Public API tests run from a consumer module on an iOS simulator.
CI enforces parity, performance, generated-source, UI, and secret checks.
No runtime or project-generator dependency is required.
macOS support is documented as future work and is not claimed by version 0.1.
Opt-in high refresh selects 1/120 instead of 1/60 without resetting playback; demo settings are shared across both tabs.
